fixedId: The item’s ID stays the same when its wording changes.
numberHint: Type each number again from the source. Leave unused fields blank.
checkFields: Check the marked fields and the item’s place in the plan.

errors.invalid: Check this value against the source.
errors.duplicate: This item ID is already used.
errors.unknown-reference: Choose an item or template that exists in this plan.

structureProblem: Check the numbers, names and references. Items must fit the chosen timing, and a template or activity still used by an item must remain. If a migration entry names an item, take the entry away first.
numberMismatch: The numbers do not match. Check them against the source.
licence: Source text allowed in this pack
statusHint: Official comes only from the Ministry's account. A published release keeps its status; the next release changes it.
sourceProblem: Check the source fields, country and release.
unsaved: Not saved yet. Add the first item to save this draft.
savedDraft: Saved draft in this demo world.
saveError: Could not read or save this draft. Keep your entries, or return to the list and reload the latest revision.
packSize: This draft is too large to publish. Shorten the plan before saving.
packHistory: Part of the release history could not be read. The releases that could be read are available for viewing. Saving is unavailable.
packDate: The demo world’s date changed. Your edits are still here. Try again after the date refreshes.
packChanged: Someone saved a newer draft, so this change was not saved.
packRole: This account may not take that step.
drafts: Drafts and releases in this world

stage.under-review: Under review — editing returns it to draft

pdfLocal: The PDF stays on this computer and must be reopened after leaving this draft.
pdfError: This PDF could not be opened or rendered. Choose it again, or use a smaller unprotected PDF (up to 32 MB and 1,000 pages).
pdfPageError: This page could not be displayed. You can try another page or reopen the PDF.
pdfDraft: Unchecked draft rows. Leading numbers may suggest weeks; check the wording and every number against the image.
pdfNoText: No text was extracted. Read the image and enter the lesson in the form.
retypeTitle: Retype the title from the page
removeAsk: Remove “{{title}}” from this draft? The change is saved straight away.
applyLatest: Apply my entry to the latest draft
packLocked: The latest revision can no longer be edited here. Go back to the packs to see it.
worldErased: This demo world was erased. Nothing more can be read or saved in it.
budgetsRechecked: I rechecked every item’s teaching time against the source in this unit
budgetsProblem: The teaching-time unit changed. Recheck every item’s number against the source, then tick the box.
pdfEngine: The PDF reader could not be loaded from the server. Check the connection, keep or note what you have typed, then reload the page. If it still fails, install the app’s update if one is offered.
latestApplyHint: Your entry is still here. Apply it to the latest draft, check it and confirm it again.
latestShowHint: Show the latest draft, then make your change again.
itemGone: This item was removed from the latest draft, so it can’t be saved here. Cancel, or add it as a new item.
packReview: This step was refused. A release needs two people’s approval to be published, and a release can hold 20 reviews; saving its draft again starts over.
